t: Migrating Jekyll from GitHub Pages to Self-Hosted NixOS via Git Push
s: This article details migrating a Jekyll blog from GitHub Pages to a self-hosted NixOS server, establishing an automated deployment workflow triggered by Git pushes. It emphasizes NixOS's 'Infrastructure as Code' capabilities for reproducible system configuration and AI's role in generating these configurations.
sub: NixOS 'Infrastructure as Code' for server configuration
Automated Jekyll deployment via Git push and SSH
Experimental SEO adjustments and their impact
Self-hosting a Jekyll blog on a home network
